- Share button in drawer: Share Dha Anywaa with friends on WhatsApp

- Share quiz score: appears on 70%+ quiz results
- Personal Best leaderboard: weekly word count vs personal record with progress bar
- Quick Challenge micro-loop: 30-second word learning sessions (coming soon)
- Audit fixes: removed dead NotificationService call, added streak/level-up celebrations to quiz results, fixed comeback bonus XP awarding, added streak_milestone and comeback_bonus_claimed analytics events
